message.content: {"caption":"Sequential skill-bank updates and parallel distillation of trace-derived lessons","description":"A two-part process diagram separated by a vertical gray dashed line. On the left, under “Traces Seq,” pink rounded boxes labeled Trace1, Trace2, Trace3, an ellipsis, and TraceN are arranged vertically. Each trace points right via a black arrow to a light-blue box labeled, respectively, Skill Bank v1, Skill Bank v2, Skill Bank v3, and Skill Bank vN. A green circular icon appears above each trace-to-bank arrow; the legend on the right identifies this icon as a “Skill Patch.” Cyan arrows point downward from Skill Bank v1 to v2 and from v2 to v3; a dotted vertical continuation indicates omitted intermediate updates before vN. The panel is labeled “Sequential Updates of a Skill Bank.” On the right, a red dashed rounded rectangle labeled “Traces Pool” contains pink boxes Trace1, Trace2, Trace3, an ellipsis, and TraceN in a row. Beneath it, green circular Skill Patch icons are arranged in three descending levels: five on the top level, three on the middle level, and one on the lower level. Thin black curved or bracket-like connectors, identified in the legend as “Patch Merge,” show the patches being combined hierarchically from the upper levels into fewer patches below. A downward connection from the lowest patch leads to a light-blue box labeled “Distilled Skill.” This panel is labeled “Parallel Distillation of All Lessons into a Skill.”","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
